title: Fairness Under Feature Exemptions: Counterfactual and Observational Measures
reasoning: The paper's primary contribution is the development of a formal, mathematical framework to quantify and evaluate fairness, a core ethical concept. It proposes an axiomatic approach inspired by legal principles (e.g., the 'business necessity defense') to measure different types of disparity. This deep engagement with operationalizing and measuring an ethical principle goes beyond a mere 'Ethical Considerations' section and constitutes a core component of evaluating ethics in machine learning.
